landmarks.name: Galápagos Islands
landmarks.writeup: A volcanic archipelago known for its unique wildlife and Charles Darwin's studies on evolution.

landmarks.name: Cotopaxi Volcano
landmarks.writeup: One of the highest active volcanoes in the world, popular for climbing and hiking.

landmarks.name: Quito Historic Center
landmarks.writeup: A UNESCO World Heritage site featuring well-preserved colonial architecture.

landmarks.name: Mitad del Mundo
landmarks.writeup: A monument marking the approximate location of the equator line.

landmarks.name: Cuenca
landmarks.writeup: A city known for its colonial buildings and rich cultural heritage.

cultural_events.name: Inti Raymi
cultural_events.writeup: An indigenous festival celebrating the sun god, held around the June solstice.

cultural_events.name: Fiestas de Quito
cultural_events.writeup: Annual celebrations in December commemorating the founding of Quito with parades and music.

cultural_events.name: Carnaval
cultural_events.writeup: A lively pre-Lenten festival featuring water fights, music, and dancing.

food_writeup: Ecuadorian cuisine is diverse, featuring dishes like ceviche, llapingachos (potato patties), and guinea pig in the highlands, with a strong emphasis on fresh seafood along the coast.
brief_history: Ecuador was part of the Inca Empire before Spanish colonization in the 16th century. It gained independence in 1822 and has since developed a diverse cultural and political landscape.
current_conflicts: Ecuador faces challenges related to illegal mining, drug trafficking, and occasional border tensions with Colombia.
